negative_snippets:
Very poor experience overall.

!!!!!!!!!!!!ALERT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
DO NOT BOOK THIS HOSTEL

Room, service, and location were all unacceptable. During the booking process, we tried contacting the hostel multiple times via WhatsApp and calls, but there was no proper response. Calls and messages were ignored, including on the day of check-in, even though we had informed them about a late check-in.

When we finally arrived, someone was already sleeping in our assigned room, which was shocking. The rooms and surroundings felt unsafe and uncomfortable, nothing like what was shown in the online reviews. The place gave a red-area / unsafe vibe, and did not feel suitable for travelers.

Due to this, we refused to check in and had to look for a new hotel at 11:30 pm, which was extremely stressful.

The person at reception was not friendly and seemed reluctant to answer questions, offering no help or reassurance.

Overall, the experience did not match the reviews online, which felt misleading. I would not recommend this hostel.

SCAMMERS !!!!

One of the worst stays I’ve experienced. Calls and WhatsApp messages were ignored during booking and even on the day of check-in. Were asked to pay deposit 50%, lucky we didn’t do that. On arrival, our room was already occupied, and the place felt unsafe and uncomfortable. The reality was completely different from the online reviews. Staff was unwelcoming, and we had to find another hotel late at night. Not recommended.
